description: List all hosts (sites) in Webmaster with their host_id — the identifier every other tool requires (format "https:example.com:443"). Take it from here instead of assembling it by hand. Use when the user asks which sites are in Webmaster or needs a host_id for any later call. Do not use it for one site SQI or problems; call get-summary or get-diagnostics after the host_id is known.
name: list-hosts
